name: ayugram
description: Telegram client with enhanced features
longDescription: AyuGram is a modified Telegram Desktop client that adds advanced privacy controls and expanded messaging features to the standard Telegram interface. It includes a flexible ghost mode to hide your online status and read receipts, as well as anti-recall functionality that saves deleted and edited message history locally. Additionally, it offers font and theme customization, built-in message translation, streamer mode, and local Telegram Premium options.

name: bees
description: btrfs deduplication daemon
longDescription: Bees is a background deduplication daemon for Btrfs filesystems that continuously scans for and consolidates duplicate data blocks to recover disk space. It operates on live filesystems and automatically self-throttles, working seamlessly alongside Btrfs snapshots, reflinks, and transparent compression. Designed for high efficiency, it uses a fixed-size persistent hash table that requires as little as 1 GB of RAM per 10 TB of unique data.

name: btrfs-assistant
description: GUI management tool for Btrfs filesystem
longDescription: Btrfs Assistant provides a graphical interface for managing Btrfs subvolumes, filesystem settings, and maintenance routines. It integrates directly with Snapper to let you browse, create, and restore system snapshots directly from the GUI. You can also use it to monitor subvolume space usage and schedule or manually run routine operations like scrubs, balances, and defragmentation.

name: fonts-noto-lite
description: Hide non-Latin/Cyrillic Noto fonts from font selection dialogs on Ubuntu/Debian
longDescription: fonts-noto-lite declutters font selection menus in Ubuntu and Debian by hiding non-Latin and non-Cyrillic Noto font families from desktop applications. It uses dpkg-divert and system fontconfig rules to disable dozens of script-specific families—such as Arabic, Thai, Devanagari, and CJK—while keeping standard Noto Sans, Serif, Mono, and Color Emoji available. Installing this package also replaces fonts-noto-extra, freeing around 334 MB of disk space without breaking base package dependencies.

name: glab
description: Official GitLab command-line tool
longDescription: `glab` is a command-line tool that lets you manage GitLab repositories, issues, merge requests, and CI/CD pipelines directly from your terminal. You can create and review merge requests, check build pipeline statuses, manage project issues, and publish releases without opening a web browser. It works with both GitLab.com and self-hosted GitLab instances.

name: grub-btrfs
description: GRUB menu entries for btrfs snapshots
longDescription: grub-btrfs automatically integrates your Btrfs system snapshots into the GRUB bootloader menu, allowing you to boot directly into previous system states during startup. It automatically detects kernels, initramfs images, and snapshot metadata generated manually or by tools like Snapper, Timeshift, and Yabsnap. Additionally, it includes a background service that automatically updates your GRUB configuration whenever snapshots are created or deleted.

name: keyd
description: Key remapping daemon
longDescription: `keyd` is a system-wide key remapping daemon for Linux that intercepts low-level inputs using evdev and uinput to remap keys across your entire system. It supports advanced features typically found in custom keyboard firmware, such as tap/hold key overloading, custom layers, hybrid modifiers, and device-specific configurations. Because it operates at the kernel level, your custom keybindings work consistently across X11, Wayland, and virtual consoles without depending on a specific desktop environment.

name: kio-stash
description: Virtual folder protocol (stash:/) for Dolphin on KDE Plasma 6
longDescription: kio-stash adds a virtual temporary folder (`stash:/`) to KDE file managers like Dolphin, allowing you to stage files and folders from different locations into a single view. Instead of creating physical temporary folders or relying on fragile multi-file selections, you can drag and drop items into the stash to organize a batch job. Once gathered, you can easily copy or move the entire staged collection to its final destination in one operation.

name: localsend
description: Cross-platform file sharing over local network
longDescription: LocalSend transfers files and text messages directly between devices on your local network without requiring an internet connection or third-party servers. It automatically detects nearby devices running the app, allowing you to quickly share documents, media, and clipboard content across Linux, Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS. Because all traffic stays within your local Wi-Fi or Ethernet connection, transfers are fast, private, and use zero internet bandwidth.

name: mc6
description: Midnight Commander with Plugins
longDescription: mc6 is an enhanced fork of GNU Midnight Commander, providing a dual-panel text-mode file manager for terminal and SSH environments. It extends the classic interface with dynamic plugins that let you browse Git repositories, Docker containers, Kubernetes clusters, and S3 buckets directly within file panels. It also includes an integrated archive manager, structured tree views for JSON and YAML, live viewer filtering, and an embedded shell terminal.

name: mc6-data
description: Midnight Commander with Plugins — data files
longDescription: This package provides the essential architecture-independent data, syntax highlighting definitions, and interface skins for `mc6`, a fork of the Midnight Commander terminal file manager. The `mc6` suite adds panel plugins for managing Git, Docker, Kubernetes, S3, and remote connections directly inside a classic two-panel text-mode interface. It is a required dependency for `mc6` to supply configuration assets, editor themes, and structured viewer templates for JSON, YAML, and XML files.

name: mc6-plugins
description: Midnight Commander with Plugins — panel plugins (git, docker, k8s, s3, samba, mongo, ftp, sftp, systemd, shell links, arcmc)
longDescription: Provides dynamic panel plugins for the `mc6` terminal file manager, allowing you to manage cloud services, containers, and network drives directly inside dual-panel views. It adds native panel integration for Git repositories, Docker containers, Kubernetes clusters, Amazon S3 buckets, MongoDB, systemd units, and Samba shares, alongside upgraded FTP and SFTP support. It also includes `arcmc`, a libarchive-powered tool for browsing, packing, and extracting compressed archives directly in your terminal.

name: rclone
description: rsync for cloud storage
longDescription: Rclone is a command-line utility that synchronizes, transfers, and manages files between your local system and cloud storage services. Acting like rsync for the cloud, it supports dozens of storage backends including Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Box, Google Drive, and S3-compatible providers. It is ideal for scripting automated offsite backups, migrating data between different cloud hosts, or mounting remote storage directly onto your local file system.

name: remotedesktopmanager
description: One application for every remote connection you'll ever open
longDescription: Remote Desktop Manager centralizes remote connection protocols into a single interface, allowing you to launch and manage SSH, RDP, VNC, and VPN sessions from one Linux application. It features built-in credential management, session grouping, and secure password vault integration to eliminate the need for multiple separate connection clients. It is built for system administrators and power users who need to maintain organized, secure access to large fleets of servers and network infrastructure.

name: rustdesk
description: Fast open-source remote desktop
longDescription: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop client that lets you remotely control a computer, share screen sessions, and transfer files. It works out of the box using default connection servers, but also allows you to set up your own self-hosted relay server for full control over your privacy and traffic. Featuring a multi-language graphical interface, it is a practical tool for remote system administration and desktop technical support.

name: scrcpy
description: Mirror and control Android devices via USB/TCP
longDescription: scrcpy mirrors your Android device's screen and audio to your desktop over USB or Wi-Fi, allowing you to fully control your phone using your computer's keyboard and mouse. It requires no root access or installed mobile apps, delivering low-latency performance with support for frame rates up to 120 FPS. Key features include screen recording, seamless two-way copy-pasting, mirroring while the phone screen remains off, and using your device's camera as a Linux webcam via V4L2.

name: viber
description: Free and secure calls and messages to anyone, anywhere
longDescription: Viber is a messaging and VoIP client that lets you make voice and video calls, send text messages, and share files with other users. The desktop application syncs with your mobile account using your phone number, allowing you to seamlessly transfer active calls between devices and manage message histories from your Linux PC. Key features include end-to-end encrypted chats, group video conferencing, screen sharing, and calling non-Viber phone numbers via Viber Out.

name: winegui
description: Wine prefix manager with a modern GUI
longDescription: WineGUI provides a clean GTK graphical interface for managing Wine prefixes and launching Windows applications on Linux. It simplifies creating, configuring, and organizing isolated Wine environments so you don't have to manage them through the terminal. Note that it requires Wine v9 or higher to be installed on your host system.

name: wlvncc
description: Wayland native VNC client
longDescription: `wlvncc` allows you to connect to and control remote VNC servers natively within a Wayland desktop environment without relying on XWayland. Built using `pixman` and `libxkbcommon`, it provides a lightweight remote desktop viewing experience with proper input handling. It is a minimalist command-line client ideal for users who want a simple, native tool to access remote machines on Wayland compositors.

name: wps-office
description: WPS Office repack with patches
longDescription: A comprehensive office suite compatible with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint formats. This is a community patched repack with fixes and improvements over the stock package, including removed telemetry and better Linux desktop integration. Includes Writer, Presentation, and Spreadsheets.

name: wps-office-langpack-ru
description: Russian language pack for WPS Office
longDescription: Russian language pack for WPS Office. Adds Russian UI translations and spell-check dictionaries to the WPS Office suite components.
